messages.subject: gmap vs pmap for permutations
parts:
Hi Karl,

For the chr_lengths argument in scan1perm, does it matter if I use the genetic map vs. the physical map? Or do I have to use a specific one?

Thanks,
Basel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] gmap vs pmap for permutations
parts:
It matters, as in they're different, but you could use either one.

chr_lengths is used only if you're getting autosome- and X-chromosome-specific threshold, in which case the lengths are used as weights. See Broman et al. (2006) https://doi.org/10.1534/genetics.106.061176

I would use the genetic lengths, because the distribution of the maximum LOD score on a chromosome depends on genetic rather than physical length.

karl
